== ======================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Partha Sarthy
 Oral Judgment
Date : 22-03-2023  Heard learned counsel for the parties.

The petitioner has filed the instant application for the  following relief(s) :
 "(i) To direct the respondent authorities  especially the Collector, East Champaran, to make re-  determination of the compensation towards the  acquired land of the petitioner under Indo-Nepal  Border Road Project, which having of residential  nature, adopting the criteria i.e. the market value of  such residential land specified under the Indian Stamp  Act for registration of Sale-deeds in the area, where the  Patna High Court CWJC No.5064 of 2020 dt.22-03-2023  2/4 Sanjay Singh vs The State Of Bihar on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/81448163/
1  land is situated and to make necessary correction,
 accordingly, in the award of Rs. 65, 60,000/- made  earlier in favour of the petitioner, which finds mention  in the notice issued in terms of Section 37 (2) of the  Right Compensation and Transparency to Fair in Land  Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013  (hereinafter referred as to the Act').
 (II) To direct the respondent authorities as to make  payment of the compensation amount so re-determined  to the petitioner with interest component towards  acquisition of his land bearing Plot No. 1252,
 measuring area of 41 decimals, appertaining to Khata  No.290, situated within the village- Nonia Deeh,
 having Revenue Thana No.85, under Circle- Raxaul  within the district of East Champaran.
 (III) For grant of any other relief(s) which may deem fit  and proper in the facts and circumstances of the present  case."
 Referring to the contents of the counter affidavit filed on  behalf of respondent nos. 1 to 4 and especially paragraph no. 11  thereof, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the  matter having been referred to the Land Acquisition,
 Rehabilitation and Resettlement Authority (LARRA),
 Muzaffarpur under section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation  and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and  Resettlement Act, 2013 (hereinafter referred to as 'the 2013  Act'), the authority concerned be directed to consider besides  other materials also the contents of the letter no 200 dated  Patna High Court CWJC No.5064 of 2020 dt.22-03-2023  3/4  8.3.2018 (Annexure-7) written by the Circle Officer, Raxaul, East Champaran to the District Land Acquisition Officer, East Champaran, Motihari.

sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing for the respondents submits that the compensation amount along with interest has already been received by the petitioner without any objection.

However, it is not disputed and in fact stated in the counter affidavit itself that the matter has been referred to the authority (LARRA).
Having heard learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration the averments made, the matter with respect to quantum of compensation already being considered by the authority (LARRA) under section 64 of the 2013 Act, it goes without saying that the authority concerned will take into consideration the submissions and the documents which are referred to and relied upon by both the parties including the letter dated 8.3.2018 referred to herein above and decide the same expeditiously in accordance with law.
The application stands disposed off with the above observations and directions.

(Partha Sarthy, J) Prakash/-
